name: kithra
description: Kithra Kyriel, a young half-elven hero with long golden-blond hair and a pointed ear under a green hood, a leafy green cloak streaming behind him over brown leather armour and brown boots, a spear with a wooden shaft and a long green leaf-shaped blade in his LEFT hand, riding a white dappled horse with a long cream mane and tail, a green bridle trimmed with leaves and dark hooves
hands: the leaf-bladed spear stays in Kithra's left hand on the screen-right side and his right hand holds the reins on the screen-left side
